help.subtitle: Guides, what's new, and help when something goes wrong.

roles.admin:
You can do everything: invite people, connect Facebook and Instagram, set the approval rules and pause posting.
You can also approve and publish any post.
roles.comms_lead:
You approve the comms team's posts, look after categories, posting times and the brand voice, and can pause posting.
Urgent posts you mark skip the extra approver.
roles.comms:
You write posts from the photo library, send them for approval and answer comments in the Inbox.
Your school may let you approve a colleague's post.
roles.principal:
You see every post and sign off the ones that need your approval (they appear on Today).
You can also see the results and the activity log.
roles.teacher: You upload photos from your phone or computer. They're checked on the school's Mac before anyone can post them.
roles.staff: You upload photos. They're checked on the school's Mac before anyone can post them.
roles.photographer: You upload event photos. They're checked on the school's Mac before anyone can post them.

start.title: Getting started
start.body: Follow the set-up checklist on Today: connect the accounts, describe your school's voice, check the categories and posting times, invite the team and install the Mac app.

post.title: Making a post
post.body: Press Create post (or N). Start from an event and the AI picks the best photos and writes three versions of the caption. Change anything, look at the Facebook and Instagram preview, then send it for approval.

approve.title: Approving posts
approve.body: The comms lead approves the team's posts. If your school uses an extra approver (usually the principal), the post goes to them next. They can approve from their phone on Today, or from an approval link.

calendar.title: The calendar
calendar.body: Drag a post to another day to move it. Dashed spots are your weekly posting times; tap one to make a post for that day. Events and occasions show on top of each day.

brand.title: Brand voice and categories
brand.body: Brand and categories holds your school's voice, the categories, posting times, frames and saved text. The AI learns from every caption you approve.

mac.title: The Mac app
mac.body: The Mac app keeps the school's photo library, recognises faces on the Mac itself, checks privacy and sends small copies to the website. Photos uploaded on the website wait for the Mac check before they can be posted.

upload.title: Uploading photos
upload.body: Open Upload on your phone, choose the event and pick the photos. Location and other hidden details are removed before upload.

pause.title: Pausing posting
pause.body: On Accounts, pause all posting for a few days (for example a day of mourning) or just one account. Scheduled posts wait and nothing is lost.

whatsNew.n1: A new look with a sidebar, dark mode and keyboard shortcuts (press ? to see them).
whatsNew.n2: The posts board: ideas, drafts, approvals and scheduled posts in one place, plus the Instagram grid view.
whatsNew.n3: The AI writes three versions of each caption, rewrites, translates and checks them, and learns your school's voice.
whatsNew.n4: Live Facebook and Instagram preview, first comment, story and a separate Instagram caption.
whatsNew.n5: The comms lead approves inside the team, with an optional extra approver and approval links.
whatsNew.n6: Today, Results, Inbox, posting times, frames and pausing posting.
